name: @mandusec/fs-sync
description: Mandu Track B (userspace half): git-worktree dual-view synchronization. Initializes the HumanView (real on-disk files) + AgentView (symbolized git worktree); symbolizes on agent read, captures agent writes, syncs AgentView->HumanView (desymbolize), re-symbolizes human-edited regions via git blame, and reverts. All symbol-table operations go through the arbiter over IPC; this package never opens the symbol DB. Lifted from adfi-openclaw (see per-file provenance headers). Fail-closed.
